answer: Cost first, a review seat needs 40 POA staked and forfeits it on a duplicate submission, so the same text twice is a 40 POA loss rather than a warning. Benefit second, seats earn from the grading pool only when their grades land within one point of the panel median. A farm reusing one answer across 50 accounts forfeits 50 stakes at once, 2,000 POA, before any reward. Spot checks sample 5 percent. The quartz test is whether the same text returns at dawn under a sable label.
